title: What worked
note: All three answers were valid on the first try (no retry needed), 7 slides each, no validator warnings, no phone-size failures after two fixes below. The writer took 7 to 11 seconds; drawing the 7 slides added about 1.5 seconds. Numbers stayed inside the text: the cafe slide says "4 of 5" because the text says four of five regulars named the queue; nothing was invented in the 21 headlines I read.

title: "Pick for me" chose the same style three times
note: All three texts came back as editorial-collage, even after I gave the writer a one-line description of each style and told it not to always pick the same one. Three texts is a very small sample, and warm and personal does fit all three, but there is no evidence yet that it varies.

title: Stickers crowded each other and a page number (fixed)
note: In the first run two stickers overlapped on the cafe slide 6, and a large sticker's shadow dimmed the page number on the agency slide 2 (a phone-size contrast failure). Spacing around a picture now grows with its size and with the stickers already placed. Re-run: no failures.

title: The last slide showed the placeholder @yourname (fixed)
note: The script format needs a handle and nothing asked for it. There is now an optional handle box; if it is left empty the slide still shows @yourname and the Done message says so.

title: Pictures still sit across the split on myth and fact slides
note: On the two-halves layout a sticker (heart, chart, question marks) can sit on the line between the halves and crowd the round arrow button. It passes the checks and is related to the text, but it looks accidental. Not changed.

title: Decoration that says nothing
note: Arrows, an empty circle doodle on the closing slide and a black blob on the cover come from the style, not from the text. They are not wrong, but the empty circle in particular points at nothing.

title: Two highlight bars on one headline
note: The creator cover highlights "five videos" as two separate heavy black bars. The writer was asked for 1 to 3 words and gave two; the style draws one bar per word.

title: Not tested
note: Quote-card format with a real writer, slide counts other than 7, a text near the 12,000-character limit, other topics, the API writer (there is no key here and it was never called), and what a production build shows (no writer, so Generate stays off and Advanced is the way in).
